## 🎬 TikTok-Now Pull Request

Thank you for contributing to **TikTok-Now**! Please fill out the sections below to help us review and merge your contribution quickly.

---

### 📝 Summary of Changes

*A clear and concise description of what this PR does, why it is needed, and how it was implemented.*

---

### 🔍 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change resolving an issue)
- [ ] ✨ Feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧹 Code health / Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🛡️ Security enhancement

---

### 🧪 Self-Verification Checklist

Please verify the following before submitting:

- [ ] My code builds cleanly via `cargo check` in `src-tauri`.
- [ ] My code produces zero warnings with `cargo clippy`.
- [ ] I have formatted my code with `cargo fmt`.
- [ ] I have tested this change locally on my operating system:
  - [ ] Windows
  - [ ] macOS
  - [ ] Linux
- [ ] All sensitive/personal information, debug logs, and local credentials have been excluded.
